defectsFoundNotParityRows.defect: P&L is hard-wired to six reserved groups, so a user-made primary Income/Expense group is on the Balance Sheet profit but not the P&L (reports.tsx:1850-1878).
Altering an old Automatic voucher after a prefix, suffix or width change rewrites its printed invoice number (VoucherScreen.tsx:2394-2397).
Group alteration allows duplicate names and a parent that is the group's own descendant; a cycle detaches the subtree from the statements.
The client never calls /sync/next-number; numbers are local max+1, so two devices can issue the same invoice number. CLAUDE.md and HANDOFF say the cloud assigns numbers; the client does not use them.
Item-invoice save rebuilds entries without costs, so cost allocations on an imported item voucher look likely to drop on the next alteration (inferred, not run).
The Interest Calculation report's empty state tells the user to set a rate in Alter Ledger, which has no such field; non-bill-wise interest is closing balance times the whole period.
Delivery Note then Sales invoice reduces stock twice and double-credits the order; no warning.
Inventory Books lists 'Batch & Expiry Summary', which opens a ComingSoon stub (the new left menu correctly omits it).
Price levels can be maintained but never reach an invoice: nothing sets the party's default level.
An alternate- or compound-unit quantity typed with a suffix is rounded to 2 decimals though units allow 4 (VoucherScreen.tsx:3052,3057).
BOM ratios and exploded quantities are rounded to 2 decimals: 5 per 1000 is stored 0.01 so a batch pulls double; 4 per 1000 drops to 0 (arithmetic run).
Altering a manufacture from Day Book opens the generic Stock Journal (the Manufacture editId path is unreachable); the screen has no assertion suite or shots recipe.
The GSTR-2B parser reads b2b, data.b2b and docdata.b2b but not data.docdata.b2b, the real portal nesting (skeptic ran it: 0 groups), so a genuinely downloaded 2B JSON may import nothing.
tdsSummary counts the whole Dr on the TDS ledger as 'paid'; the challan panel tells the user to put interest and fee inside that debit, so TDS Outstanding understates tax payable by the interest/fee.
A Debit Note reversal is netted by the register but dropped from the deduction list that feeds Deductee-wise, the 26Q annexure and Form 16A (they show the gross).
Attendance Register adds present days, absent days, overtime hours and units into one 'Total Days' figure.

HR leave screens and beyond row b-hr say unpaid leave is deducted in payroll; no payroll code reads leave applications. No payroll assertion suite or sample payroll data exists; an unmarked employee silently gets 26 days.
Payment Advice labels any payment with no instrument type 'NEFT' and collapses a split payment to its first instrument.
Post-dated cheques are modelled twice (instrument date later than voucher date, and the Ctrl+T flag), so the two registers can disagree.
exportReportXLS has a listener but nothing dispatches 'tw-exportxls', so the .xls path is dead code (and writes HTML, not .xlsx).
The top-bar Share item has no handler and renders disabled ('Not available in MVP'); at 390 px the left rail stays open and the Trial Balance is clipped to about 160 px.
Edit Log is device-local; 'Deleted By' reads the sync account not the operator; AuditLog prior-version scan is O(n^2); Shut Company is reachable only from the admin-only Backup/Restore screen.
Wave A's universal '+' claims Alt+Q, which is TallyPrime's Edit Log chord (collision for a future per-record Edit Log).
